channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Can Iran retaliate against countries that join US ‘economic war’?
item.description: Iran warns that countries backing US economic sanctions will be considered an enemy of Tehran.

item.title: Israeli air strike near Gaza refugee camp kills one person and injures two
item.description: Israeli air attack near Gaza's Maghazi camp kills one person and injures two others.

item.title: 37 injured as magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes eastern Japan
item.description: 37 injured as magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes eastern Japan

item.title: DR Congo, M23 rebels agree on roadmap for peace talks
item.description: Roadmap sets out steps, timelines for talks to end fighting that has killed thousands and displaced millions.

item.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
item.description: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

item.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
item.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

item.title: Syria says Israeli strike near Damascus violation of international law
item.description: The latest incident comes days after reports emerged Israel had struck a military airbase close to the Turkish border.

item.title: Fourteen killed in strike on Myanmar monastery
item.description: A rescue worker said the site had been struck twice as civilians gathered for a meditation retreat.

item.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
item.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
item.description: The defence brought their final witness - a forensic psychiatrist - to the stand to testify about the effects of postpartum psychosis.
